description: The chest is a major pushing muscle. It helps with pressing, upper-body strength, and overall muscle development.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: A compound movement that builds overall chest strength.
exercises.tips: Keep your back flat on the bench and lower the bar under control.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Focuses on the upper chest and shoulders.
exercises.tips: Move slowly and avoid flaring elbows too much.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.description: A bodyweight finisher for chest endurance and control.
exercises.tips: Keep your body in a straight line and lower until your chest nearly touches the floor.

description: The back includes the lats, traps, and rear delts. It is important for posture, pulling strength, and upper body power.

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.description: A strong vertical pull movement for the lats and upper back.
exercises.tips: Pull your elbows down and avoid swinging your body.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Row
exercises.description: Builds thickness in the mid-back and helps with pulling strength.
exercises.tips: Keep your chest up and row with your elbows, not your hands.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: A safe and effective lat-building exercise.
exercises.tips: Pull the bar to the upper chest and keep shoulder blades down and back.

description: The biceps are the front upper-arm muscles responsible for elbow flexion and forearm control.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.description: A classic movement that builds arm size and strength.
exercises.tips: Keep your elbows close and avoid swinging during the lift.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.description: Targets the long head of the biceps for better arm shape.
exercises.tips: Extend the arms fully and curl with control.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.description: Works the biceps and brachialis for stronger arms.
exercises.tips: Keep your wrists neutral and avoid leaning back.

description: The triceps are the back of the upper arm and are involved in almost all pressing movements.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.description: Heavy compound movement that develops triceps power.
exercises.tips: Keep elbows tucked close to the body.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.description: Isolation exercise to target the triceps head.
exercises.tips: Lower slowly and do not lock elbows hard at the top.

exercises.name: Cable Pushdown
exercises.description: Great for slower tension and triceps pump.
exercises.tips: Keep your shoulders down and avoid leaning forward.

description: The shoulders help with pressing, posture, and upper-body stability. They are made of deltoid heads that work together.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.description: A main shoulder builder that strengthens the entire deltoid region.
exercises.tips: Brace the core and move the bar in a straight line.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.description: Targets the side delts for shoulder width.
exercises.tips: Lift through the shoulder and avoid swinging the weights.

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.description: Improves rear delt work and posture.
exercises.tips: Pull toward your face and keep elbows high.

description: The legs include the quads, hamstrings, glutes, and calves. They are the foundation for overall athletic performance.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.description: One of the best lower-body strength exercises.
exercises.tips: Keep your chest up and descend deep without losing form.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: Builds hamstrings and glutes while improving posterior chain strength.
exercises.tips: Hinge at the hips and keep the bar close to the body.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.description: Improves balance and unilateral leg strength.
exercises.tips: Step forward under control and keep your knee tracking over the toes.

description: The abs help with trunk stability, posture, and force transfer during gym lifts.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Isometric core exercise that develops stability.
exercises.tips: Keep your body in a straight line and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.description: Targets the lower abs and helps improve core strength.
exercises.tips: Raise your knees with control and avoid swinging.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.description: A strong abdominal isolation movement.
exercises.tips: Crunch by pulling your ribs down and not lifting the shoulders too much.
